description: Typed HTML components in pure Python with t-strings. Type checkers validate the markup. Pairs with htmx and works with Starlette, FastAPI, Django or no framework.
rules: Ludic 1.x needs Python 3.14+ and mixes text with elements in t-strings: p(t"Hello {b('World')}!"). Use f-strings only in projects on Ludic 0.5.x.
Set plugins = ["ludic.mypy_plugin"] for mypy and run mypy after changes. Only mypy with the plugin checks the attributes passed to components.
Text children are escaped. Wrap only trusted HTML in Safe, never user input.
The HTTP methods of an Endpoint (get, post, put, ...) are classmethods that usually return Self; render() builds the HTML.
Read form data with a handler parameter typed Parser[SomeAttrs] and call .validate(), which returns the TypedDict or raises a 400 ValidationError.
Use request.url_path_for(...) or the .path of url_for(...) in links and hx_* attributes, so a forged Host header cannot change them.
Prefer the catalog (ludic.catalog.pages, layouts, forms, tables) to building pages from raw div elements.
